subtitles.zh: 你采访了这些家长和青少年，他们怎么说？青少年们很兴奋想参与其中。
subtitles.en: You talked to a bunch of these parents and teens. What did they tell you? Yeah, so the teens are excited to get into it.

subtitles.zh: 他们非常兴奋想开始配置，也很兴奋去做研究。
subtitles.en: They're very excited to get invested. They're very excited to do the research.

subtitles.zh: 当然，他们也期待看到收益。而家长们则担心孩子长大后经济会是什么样子。
subtitles.en: They're excited to see the gains as well, of course. And the parents are kind of worried about what the economy is going to look like when they get older.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们觉得，很高兴能有这个作为他们的基础。
subtitles.en: So they're like nice, excited to have this as a backbone for them.

subtitles.zh: 这不同于在沙发上用笔记本电脑进行日内交易。
subtitles.en: This is separate for day trading with a laptop off a couch.

subtitles.zh: 是的，完全不同。丽莎·马特奥的孩子们，他们精力充沛，可能会一天进行上千次交易。
subtitles.en: Yes, it's much separate. Lisa Mateo's kids. They're just power and they're going to like the president a thousand trades a day.

subtitles.zh: 感觉他们在这方面有点领先。但许多家长想让孩子尽早开始配置，是因为他们觉得自己当年没有这样做。
subtitles.en: It feels like they're a little bit ahead on this. But the motivation for a lot of parents wanting to start their kids on investing early is because they feel like they didn't do that themselves.

subtitles.zh: 是的，所以真的是想抓住时间优势。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so it's really trying to get the time behind the time.

subtitles.zh: 他们想要的是时间。家长们觉得自己当年也没有时间。
subtitles.en: Like the time is what they want to get on. Parents feel like they didn't have the time as well.

subtitles.zh: 他们开始得有点晚。所以他们试图让复利增长，确保孩子能获得最好的起步。
subtitles.en: They kind of started a little bit late. So they're trying to get that compounding interest to grow and make sure their kids have the best head start that they can.

subtitles.zh: 这些孩子会**大型科技股和ETF吗？
subtitles.en: And are these kids investing in big tech names in ETS?

subtitles.zh: 他们在哪里买入？据Schwab的Fisher说，他们主要关注个股。
subtitles.en: Where do they buy? Yeah, so according to Schwab, I spoke to Schwab's Fisher for the story.

subtitles.zh: 有些也买ETF，但大型科技股对他们特别有吸引力。
subtitles.en: They're mostly focusing in on single stocks. Some of them are also going into ETFs, but the big tech names are really attractive to them.

subtitles.zh: 比如苹果、亚马逊、谷歌，这些天天上头条的公司。
subtitles.en: It's Apple, Amazon, Google, all the ones that you hear on the headlines every day.

subtitles.zh: 你的研究有没有涉及“学会亏钱的乐趣”？
subtitles.en: Did you and your research do anything on the joy of learning to lose money?

subtitles.zh: 对我来说，这是最重要的游戏——亏钱的乐趣。
subtitles.en: To me, that's a number one game. The joy of losing money.

subtitles.zh: 我在Westinghouse期权上亏过钱，那时我一周都刮不了一次胡子。
subtitles.en: I lost money on Westinghouse options when I couldn't shave once a week.

subtitles.zh: 有意思吧？你就是这样学会亏钱的。
subtitles.en: Interesting, right? And you learn how to lose money.
